text: The deterministic execution of smart contracts rigidly enforces coded terms and thereby incentivizes participants to exploit loopholes for immediate gain, because no mechanism exists to adapt the rules contextually.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218

isBasedOn.name: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era

abstract: Conversely, smart contracts' deterministic execution rigidly enforces coded terms, incentivizing participants to exploit loopholes for immediate gain, as there is no mechanism to adapt rules contextually.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: smart contracts without on chain amendment or human review mechanisms
